Title: AppVersion
Description: Semantic version of the deployed canvas app. Written into every telemetry row. Bump with the release tag.

Title: SchemaVersion
Description: Schema version this app expects. The app warns on scrDiagnostics if it does not match what scripts/eom_schema.py declares.

Title: TenantCloud
Description: UsGov | UsGovHigh | UsGovDod. MUST be set before provisioning. Provision-MFOpsLists.ps1 refuses to run while this is UNKNOWN. See docs/government-environment-mode.md.

Title: PacCliAuthorized
Description: TRUE | FALSE | UNKNOWN. Whether the build is permitted to run PAC CLI against this tenant. Does not change the design; changes the deployment path.

Title: SiteUrl
Description: SharePoint site collection URL. No URL is hard-coded anywhere in the app or the flows; everything reads this key.

Title: EvidenceLibraryPath
Description: Server-relative path of the evidence document library that EOM-05 writes to and EOM-02 watches at library level.

Title: PortfolioRootPath
Description: Root under which the Portfolio FY folders live. Files dropped here are discovered by EOM-02 and routed to Needs Classification.

Title: MaintenanceMode
Description: Kill switch. true sends every user without Developer_Flag to scrMaintenance before any data source is opened.

Title: ReadOnlyMode
Description: true disables every write affordance in the app AND makes the upload and QC flows refuse to write. Enforced in both places; the disabled control is a courtesy and the flow check is the control.

Title: MaintenanceMessage
Config_Value: Mission Feeding Operations is temporarily unavailable for scheduled maintenance. Your submissions are safe. Try again after the window closes.
Description: Shown on scrMaintenance. Plain language; no ticket numbers.

Title: DueSoonWindowDays
Description: Days before Suspense_Date at which an unsubmitted item becomes DUE_SOON (Amber). See docs/status-calculation.md step 8c.

Title: MaxUploadSizeMB
Description: Rejected at the app before the flow is called and again inside the flow.

Title: DefaultPageSize
Description: Gallery page size. Kept well under the delegation ceiling so a truncated result is visible rather than silent.

Title: DelegationWarningThreshold
Description: scrDiagnostics warns when a result set approaches this. The hard SharePoint ceiling is 2000 rows on a non-delegable query.

Title: TelemetrySamplingPercent
Description: Percentage of ScreenView events written. Upload
Effective_To: AccessDenied and Error are always written regardless of this value.

Title: SupportContact
Description: Shown on scrNoAccess and scrMaintenance. Replace at deploy.

Title: OpenPeriodLookbackMonths
Description: How many closed periods remain visible in the app for reference. R1 does not backfill periods older than this.

Title: QCReturnRequiresComment
Description: Enforced by EOM-04 and the QC flow. A return without a comment and a new suspense date is rejected. Do not set false.
